# Canonical clauses the specializer installed on main BEFORE the unfolder
# took _SpecTarget instead of the class (F1 row 35), variables renamed in
# order of appearance.  tests/test_spec_target_is_data.py compares against it
# after renumbering variables PER CLAUSE, so a name shared between two
# clauses here (V4 in cpd_graph, say) is NOT asserted -- only each clause's
# own structure is.
== SolveNatnum/1 fields=('GOALS',)
('SolveNatnum', V0) :- [Unify(left=V0, right=[])]
('SolveNatnum', [['natnum', 0], StarUnpack(value=V1)]) :- [Call(func=LoadName(name='SolveNatnum'), args=[V1], kwargs=[])]
('SolveNatnum', [['natnum', ['s', V2]], StarUnpack(value=V3)]) :- [Call(func=LoadName(name='SolveNatnum'), args=[[['natnum', V2], StarUnpack(value=V3)]], kwargs=[])]
== solve_factorial/1 fields=('GOALS',)

('solve_factorial', [['factorial', 0, 1], StarUnpack(value=V1)]) :- [Call(func=LoadName(name='solve_factorial'), args=[V1], kwargs=[])]
('solve_factorial', [['factorial', V2, V3], StarUnpack(value=V4)]) :- [Call(func=LoadName(name='solve_factorial'), args=[[['gt', V2, 0], ['sub', V2, 1, V5], ['factorial', V5, V6], ['mul', V2, V6, V3], StarUnpack(value=V4)]], kwargs=[])]
('solve_factorial', [V7, StarUnpack(value=V8)]) :- [Call(func=LoadName(name='_SolveGoal_solve_factorial'), args=[V7], kwargs=[]), Call(func=LoadName(name='solve_factorial'), args=[V8], kwargs=[])]
